freeze: freeze a GraphModule by inlining non-mutated parameters into constants and running constant folding passes
replace_params_with_constants: replace parameters in a GraphModule with constants where possible and return preserved input indices
convert_conv_weights_to_channels_last: convert 4d convolution weight tensors to channels last format before freezing for constant folding
enforce_output_layout: enforce output node layout by adding as_strided nodes to prevent stride changes from compiler optimizations
invalidate_eager_modules: invalidate eager modules by replacing parameters with ErasedTensor to detect post-freezing usage errors
